data.title: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer
data.company_profile: CloudSphere Technologies is an enterprise cloud observability platform founded in 2017. Headquartered in San Francisco with remote hubs in Austin and London, we serve over 400 global enterprises with automated telemetry pipelines and distributed systems monitoring.
data.description: We are looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to join our Core Platform Engineering team. In this role, you will design, develop, and scale high-throughput microservices using TypeScript, Node.js, and React. You will partner with product managers and distributed infrastructure engineers to deliver real-time analytics dashboards handling millions of events per second.

data.benefits: Competitive salary, 401(k) matching up to 5%, comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance, unlimited PTO, and home office wellness stipend.
